Replace these files with your own licensed images while keeping the filenames:
- court-hero.jpg: 1600 × 1000 pickleball court or game photo
- club-1.jpg, club-2.jpg, club-3.jpg: 900 × 600 club cover photos
- gcash-qr.png: your real GCash merchant QR, clear and uncropped. Never use a fake QR.
The UI displays designed image placeholders until these files are present.
